answer_1.quote: We explore a new task: personalized target-oriented dialogue... We quantitatively evaluate TOPDIAL using representative dialogue models, including DialoGPT and Alpaca-7B ...

answer_2.quote: We quantitatively evaluate TOPDIAL using ... average score of BLEU-1/2 , persona F1 , knowledge F1 and target success rate (Succ.) ...

answer_3.quote: For LLM-based automatic evaluation, we employ the gpt-3.5-turbo version of ChatGPT to compare each pair of dialogues ... We ask ChatGPT ... to compare each pair of dialogues in terms of the following metrics: proactivity, coherence, personalization, target success rate.

answer_4.quote: We recruit three well-educated graduate students as evaluators and ask them to perform a blind pairwise comparison... We ask ChatGPT and human evaluators to compare each pair of dialogues in terms of the following metrics: proactivity, coherence, personalization, target success rate.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators answer which dialogue shows more initiative (proactivity), is more natural and coherent (coherence), reflects user preferences/personality (personalization), and successfully achieves the target act (target success rate).
